changes.summary: Confirmed original research was catalogue metadata only; preserved Claude's 1 Draft / 99 Held placeholder evaluation for reference.
Researched 156 candidates from inspected secondary profiles with canonical-reference leads; classified 87 research-ready, 31 partial, 38 insufficient.
Applied substantive-evidence gate, canon default against adaptation-only evidence, and continuity/artwork exclusions. Final count is 62, with no padding to 100.
Retained 35 original candidates and added 27 better-documented Naruto-era replacements; 65 original candidates moved to unresolved.
Excluded Shin Uchiha as clone-group/Boruto-era ambiguity, distinguished Shin (Root), kept Kosuke/Kōsuke identities separate, and kept Enma as manual identity mapping.
Reused validated artwork, excluded Musai after HTTP 404, and revalidated the final set: 63 valid images covering all 62 candidates.
Added staged completeness validation and focused tests so metadata-only fields cannot be reported as substantive research.
Rebuilt the self-contained Claude assignment for 62 candidates; no ratings, rarity, approval or dataset integration performed.
